title: All AI usage must be tracked (AI Gateway metadata or core-guardian)

detect.signal: code calls an LLM / AI model (Workers AI, AI Gateway, or a provider SDK / REST endpoint) — its token usage and spend must be tracked

directive: Any code that calls an LLM / AI model MUST have its usage tracked — one of the two conditions below (sometimes both) MUST be met. (1) Route the call through Cloudflare AI Gateway with metadata so core-guardian meters it automatically. On a Worker: use env.AI.run(model, input, { gateway: { id: env.GATEWAY_ID, metadata: {...} } }), OR get the gateway base URL with env.AI.gateway(env.GATEWAY_ID).getUrl(provider) — that returns the full URL with the Cloudflare account id already embedded and needs no auth — and point the provider SDK's baseURL at it. Direct Workers AI via the Cloudflare REST API MUST be ported to AI Gateway with metadata fields; rare exceptions only. (2) When a call genuinely can't go through the gateway — e.g. Gemini's latest interactions API, or OpenAI-compat which now only works via the Workers AI REST API directly (no AI Gateway support) — use the native provider SDK AND register the usage with core-guardian via POST https://core-guardian.hacolby.workers.dev/api/guardian/usage/register (Bearer WORKER_API_KEY). Non-Worker code has no AI binding: read CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID and CLOUDFLARE_AI_GATEWAY_TOKEN from a local tokens.ts / tokens.py module (backed by `tokens show <name> --value-only`, the local equivalent of Workers secret-store bindings) and either call the gateway URL directly or register usage with core-guardian. Never let AI spend go untracked. When you reference core-guardian in a review comment, paste the register helper from the fix examples so the fix is copy-paste ready.

fix_examples.label: Worker + AI Gateway (preferred): env.AI.run meters automatically via metadata
core-guardian register helper (reuse when a call can't go through the gateway)
Gateway can't proxy (Gemini interactions API / Workers AI OpenAI-compat): native SDK + register
Non-Worker (TypeScript): tokens.ts — local equivalent of secret-store bindings
Non-Worker (Python): tokens.py — local equivalent of secret-store bindings

evidence: Untracked AI spend can't be attributed per-worker/model in core-guardian. AI Gateway metadata or an explicit usage/register call is the only way spend shows up.
